sources.quote: Images are tokenized for billing: up to 384 tokens each, at V4-Flash pricing
sources.supports: DeepSeek says the vision model uses the provider's V4-Flash prices, establishing it was priced with that model at launch.

sources.quote: New pricing takes effect at 04:00 UTC on Sept 10, 2026.
sources.supports: DeepSeek gives the exact effective time for the new API pricing.

sources.quote: V4-Flash & V4-Flash-Vision-Exp are retired. For compatibility, deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp temporarily route to V4.1-Flash.
sources.supports: DeepSeek confirms the affected legacy vision model name now routes to V4.1-Flash.

sources.quote: The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.
sources.supports: DeepSeek confirms requests using the vision model's legacy name are billed at the new Flash price.

notes: DeepSeek’s August 21 launch note says the vision model used V4-Flash pricing, and its September 10 announcement states that new pricing took effect at 04:00 UTC while routing the legacy vision name to V4.1-Flash. The provider’s current page does not state the prior numeric rates, and web.archive.org was unavailable, so the previous-price fields are null.
